landing.heroSubtitle: ID-verified workers. Upfront budgets. Dispute protection built in.
landing.featuredDesc: Post a task in any category. Set your budget. Get matched with verified Taskers nearby.
landing.featCleaningDesc: Apartments, offices, move-out cleans. Set your budget, pick a time, get matched.
landing.featRepairDesc: Plumbing, furniture assembly, appliance fixes. All Taskers are ID-verified.
landing.featElectricDesc: Light fixtures, wiring, panel work. Fixed price upfront — no hourly surprises.
landing.featMovingDesc: Studio to apartment, office relocations, heavy lifting. Post your move, set the budget, and pick from verified Taskers.
landing.howItWorksSub: A simple, secure, and transparent ecosystem designed to bridge trust between customers and vetted professionals.
landing.customerDesc: Get your to-do list done securely.
landing.cStep1Desc: Describe what you need done, set your budget, and choose a time & location.
landing.cStep2Desc: Review profiles, ratings, and past work of interested Taskers before hiring.
landing.cStep3Desc: Your money is held safely in escrow until the job is completed to your satisfaction.
landing.taskerDesc: Find flexible work and earn securely.
landing.tStep1Desc: Browse a live feed of tasks near you that match your skills.
landing.tStep2Desc: Apply to tasks you want to do with a quick message to the customer.
landing.tStep3Desc: Focus on the work knowing that the customer has already funded the task.
landing.trustPainLine: 10 phone calls. 3 no-shows. 1 stranger at your door.
landing.trustProof1: Every Tasker is ID-verified before their first job
landing.trustProof2: Fixed price upfront. No haggling, no surprises.
landing.trustProof3: Mandatory reviews build real, portable reputation
landing.appTitle: Take back your free time, anywhere.
landing.appDesc: Download the Tasky mobile app to post jobs, track Taskers, and handle everything on the go.
landing.footerDesc: Mongolia's premier platform for trusted domestic services. Connecting verified professionals with homes that need them, safely and efficiently.
landing.promiseSub: We built Tasky because finding help shouldn’t feel like a gamble. Accountability is built into our foundation.
landing.pillar1Desc: Every single Tasker must pass a strict identity check before joining. No anonymous profiles. Zero burner accounts.
landing.pillar2Desc: Taskers are financially incentivized to do a great job. A high rating is their livelihood—they have every reason to be punctual and polite.
landing.pillar3Desc: If a Tasker no-shows or work isn't up to standard, our local Ulaanbaatar support team is here to mediate and resolve the issue.
